item.text: The 138 questions fall into six query shapes. I’m checking the filters for verified dispositions, whole-document scope, release, and revision direction before generating the file. The schema gives property names but no allowed values, so those filters need explicit assumptions.

import json,re,collections

groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
for item in p['items']:
    q=re.sub(r'R5-\\d+|RP-\\d+|Rel-\\d+|CR \\d+|TS [\\d.-]+|clause (?"'!of'"\\b)\\S+', '<value>', item['question'])

for q,ids in groups.items():
    print(len(ids), q)

item.text: For revision questions, I’m including every later version reachable through `REVISED_TO`. For dispositions, I’m using `DISPOSITION_TARGET` to identify the document. I’ll check all IDs and return-column order in memory before writing the output.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,collections
with open('packet.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    packet=json.load(f)
items=packet['items']
assert len(items)==138
assert len({item['id'] for item in items})==138

def literal(value):
    return \"'\"+value.replace('\\\\','\\\\\\\\').replace(\"'\", \"\\\\'\")+\"'\"

def normalized(expr, upper=False):
    fn='toUpper' if upper else 'toLower'
    return f\"replace(replace(replace({fn}(toString({expr})), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')\"

verified=(
    normalized('dd.evidenceStatus')+\" = 'sourceverified'\\n\"
    '  AND '+normalized('r.resolutionScope')+\" IN ['wholedocument', 'document', 'wholetdoc', 'tdoc', 'fulldocument', 'fulltdoc', 'documentlevel', 'tdoclevel', 'documentwide', 'tdocwide']\\n\"
    '  AND '+normalized('m.workingGroup',upper=True)+\" IN ['RAN5', 'RANWG5', 'R5', 'TSGRAN5', 'TSGRANWG5']\"
)
decision=(
    'MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(dd:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(c:Tdoc)\\n'
    'MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)'
)
expressions={
    'document':'c.tdocNumber',
    'final_document':'c.tdocNumber',
    'disposition':'dd.dispositionCode',
    'wg_meeting':'m.meetingNumber',
    'cr_pack':'p.crPackId',
    'tsg_meeting':'p.tsgMeeting',
    'clause':'s.sectionNumber',
}
rows=[]
shapes=collections.Counter()
examples={}
for item in items:
    q=item['question']
    fields=item['fields']
    refs=re.findall(r'R5-\\d+',q)
    if q.startswith('In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request '):
        shape='pack'
        assert fields==['cr_pack','tsg_meeting']
        assert len(refs)==1
        query=(
            'MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n'
            'WHERE (c:Tdoc OR c:CR) AND c.tdocNumber = '+literal(refs[0])
        )
    elif q.startswith('Which Rel-'):
        shape='clause_release'
        assert fields==['document','disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack']
        release,clause,spec=re.search(r'Which Rel-(\\d+) change requests that modify clause (\\S+) of TS (\\S+) have ',q).groups()
        query=(
            decision+'\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {specNumber: '+literal(spec)+', sectionNumber: '+literal(clause)+'})\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release)\\n'
            'WHERE '+verified+'\\n'
            '  AND '+normalized('coalesce(rel.releaseName, rel.id)')+' IN ['+', '.join(literal(value) for value in [release,'rel'+release,'release'+release])+']'
        )
    elif q.startswith('Change request '):
        shape='decision_pack'
        assert fields==['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting']
        assert len(refs)==1
        query=(
            decision+'\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n'
            'WHERE c.tdocNumber = '+literal(refs[0])+'\\n'
            '  AND '+verified
        )
    elif q.startswith('Trace change request '):
        shape='trace'
        assert fields==['disposition','wg_meeting','cr_pack','tsg_meeting','clause']
        assert len(refs)==1
        specs=re.findall(r'TS (\\d+\\.\\d+(?:-\\d+)?)',q)
        assert len(set(specs))==1
        query=(
            decision+'\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {specNumber: '+literal(specs[0])+'})\\n'
            'WHERE c.tdocNumber = '+literal(refs[0])+'\\n'
            '  AND '+verified
        )
    elif q.startswith('RAN5 recorded document '):
        shape='revision'
        assert fields==['final_document','disposition','cr_pack']
        assert len(refs)==1
        query=(
            'MATCH (start:Tdoc {tdocNumber: '+literal(refs[0])+'})-[:REVISED_TO*1..]->(c:Tdoc)\\n'
            +decision+'\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n'
            'WHERE c <> start\\n'
            '  AND '+verified
        )
    elif q.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack '):
        shape='pack_decisions'
        assert fields==['document','disposition','wg_meeting']
        packs=re.findall(r'RP-\\d+',q)
        assert len(packs)==1
        query=(
            decision+'\\n'
            'MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack {crPackId: '+literal(packs[0])+'})\\n'
            'WHERE '+verified
        )
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Unrecognized question: '+item['id'])
    query+='\\nRETURN DISTINCT '+', '.join(expressions[field]+' AS '+field for field in fields)
    assert re.findall(r'\\bAS\\s+(\\w+)',query.split('RETURN DISTINCT ',1)[1])==fields
    assert query.count('RETURN DISTINCT ')==1
    outside_literals=re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\", \"''\",query)
    assert not re.search(r'\\b(?:CREATE|MERGE|SET|DELETE|DETACH|REMOVE|DROP|CALL|LOAD|UNION|UNWIND|OPTIONAL|FOREACH|ORDER|LIMIT|SKIP)\\b',outside_literals)
    assert not re.search(r'[;"'$]'"',outside_literals)
    rows.append({'id':item['id'],'cypher':query})
    shapes[shape]+=1
    examples.setdefault(shape,query)

assert [row['id'] for row in rows]==[item['id'] for item in items]
normalized_shapes={re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\", \"'VALUE'\",row['cypher']) for row in rows}
assert len(normalized_shapes)==6
schema_labels=set(re.findall(r'\\(:([A-Za-z]\\w*)',packet['task']))
schema_relationships=set(re.findall(r'\\[:([A-Za-z]\\w*)',packet['task']))
for row in rows:
    assert set(re.findall(r'\\[:([A-Za-z]\\w*)',row['cypher']))<=schema_relationships
    assert set(re.findall(r'(?<"'!'"\\[):([A-Z][A-Za-z]*)',row['cypher']))<=schema_labels
lines=[json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False) for row in rows]
assert all(json.loads(line)==row for line,row in zip(lines,rows))
with open('queries.jsonl','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps({'queries_written':len(rows),'distinct_query_shapes':len(normalized_shapes),'shape_counts':dict(shapes)},ensure_ascii=False))
for shape,query in examples.items():
    print('\\n'+shape+'\\n'+query)
PY"
